requiredBehaviors.behavior: raise a high or blocking finding for brand asset incoherence
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Brand-and-context gate violations are at least high and may be blocking when mandatory brand identity is missing or foreign.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: compare motif form language and color family across logo favicon and app icon
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The branding coherence axis explicitly checks motif, form language, color world and small-size recognizability across assets.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: recommend the smallest change that restores one recognizable brand family
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Every finding must contain the smallest useful change and verification criterion.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: approve the assets because each looks polished independently
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The review evaluates brand-family coherence rather than isolated asset polish.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: treat favicon and app icon as unrelated decorative files
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The brand-asset-coherence gate treats logo, favicon and app icon as one system.
